title: JobBrief
description: The explicit brief that opens a job (PRD REQ-002, object table §5). Every required property below is a REQ-002 'require' item; the optional block is REQ-002's optional list. `cutdown brief` is non-interactive — a missing required field fails naming the field, it is never inferred, because an inferred audience or objective silently changes what the whole pipeline optimises for.

changelog.reason: Initial v1. Fixes accountId as a stable owner-issued identifier (decisions.md D-36) so status reporting cannot be split by a display-name change, and models the CTA as a tagged union so 'no CTA' is an explicit editorial choice rather than an empty string.

parentBriefId.description: The revision this one supersedes, or null for the first. PRD §5 makes JobBrief versioned: a revision is a new object with a parent link, never an in-place edit.

accountId.description: Stable owner-issued account identifier (decisions.md D-36). `cutdown status --phase0` groups the '3 accounts' exit criterion by THIS value only. A display-name change must never create a new account in status reporting — which is exactly why the human-readable name lives in a separate optional field.

accountDisplayName.description: Human-readable label. Never used for grouping or counting.

platforms.description: One or more target platforms (REQ-002). REQ-050 produces a distinct PlatformEDL per entry. At Phase 0 only `tiktok` resolves to a capability fixture (decisions.md D-3); `plan` fails explicitly on any other member rather than falling back to a generic profile.

durationRange.title: DurationRange
durationRange.description: Desired output duration window (REQ-002). Integer seconds — this is a brief parameter, not timecode, so it does not use the rational representation. `maxSeconds >= minSeconds` is enforced in the brief resolver, not in schema (tech-spec §3 forbids if/then/else).

locale.description: BCP-47 language[-region]. decisions.md D-4 fixes Phase 0 at `en-AU`; the pattern permits others so the first non-English job is a data change plus a D-4 revisit, not a schema bump.

contentPromise.description: What the viewer is promised (REQ-002). The critic checks the delivered edit against this; a hook that overpromises relative to it is a REQ-038 finding.

cta.title: CtaDirective
cta.description: Primary CTA, or an explicit declaration of none (REQ-002: 'primary CTA or "no CTA"'). Tagged union rather than a nullable string so 'we deliberately chose no CTA' and 'nobody filled this in' are different states.

variantCount.description: How many distinct CreativeBriefs `propose` should return (REQ-002). REQ-036 permits returning fewer with a stated reason when the footage cannot support genuinely distinct angles — fewer-with-a-reason is a valid result, padding is not.

proofRequirements.description: Claims that must be evidenced on screen. The deterministic editorial gate (decisions.md D-37) blocks an EDL whose required evidence links do not resolve — so this list has teeth, it is not guidance.

prohibitedClaims.description: Claims this brand may not make. A prohibited claim appearing in an EDL is a NON-WAIVABLE deterministic block (decisions.md D-35/D-37) — never an advisory critic finding.
